rationale: Matching sealed-box identifiers and reliable post-assembly transfer records establish documented packet handling. They do not establish its original authorial arrangement or prove that arrangement remained unchanged. The competing histories differ in internal order before the documented interval.

signal_basis.exact_text: The sealed-box identifiers match at every transfer.
No entry describes internal leaf position, revision, attachment or binding, and all entries postdate assembly.
The histories differ only in pre-accession internal order, not later handling.
